reported_problem: Ventilator displaying a persistent high-pressure alarm during mechanical ventilation. Alarm recurs within minutes of being cleared, even after checking for circuit kinks and reconnecting the patient circuit.
clinical_context: Patient is on volume-controlled ventilation post-operatively. Nursing staff report the alarm has sounded intermittently over the last two hours.
immediate_action_taken: Circuit checked and reconnected twice; alarm returned each time
patient_impact_observed: No desaturation observed; patient remains stable on current settings
additional_notes: Same alarm reported by two different shift nurses

reported_problem: Infusion pump stopped delivering fluid mid-infusion and displayed an occlusion alarm. Tubing was checked for kinks and clamps were confirmed open, but the alarm persisted after restart.
clinical_context: Pump was running a scheduled IV fluid infusion on a general ward patient.
immediate_action_taken: Tubing inspected, line unclamped, device restarted once
patient_impact_observed: Infusion delayed by approximately 20 minutes; no adverse event
additional_notes: First reported issue with this specific pump

reported_problem: Analyzer is producing inconsistent results on quality control samples, with values falling outside the expected control range on two consecutive runs.
clinical_context: Routine morning quality control check before running patient samples.
immediate_action_taken: Re-ran QC sample once with same result; analyzer taken out of use for patient testing
patient_impact_observed: No patient samples processed on the affected analyzer since detection
additional_notes: Backup analyzer in the lab is being used in the meantime

reported_problem: Patient monitor is showing intermittent dropouts in the SpO2 waveform, with the numeric reading occasionally freezing for several seconds before resuming.
clinical_context: Patient is stable and alert; the same finger probe has been in place for the current shift.
immediate_action_taken: Probe repositioned on a different finger once; issue recurred after about ten minutes
patient_impact_observed: No clinical deterioration observed; nursing staff are relying on manual spot checks in between
additional_notes: Unclear whether the probe, cable, or monitor itself is the source

reported_problem: Syringe pump paused unexpectedly during a continuous infusion. The display returned to the home screen without an audible alarm, and the infusion had to be manually restarted.
clinical_context: Pump was in use for a scheduled medication infusion; staff are unsure whether the pause was linked to a battery event, since the pump had been briefly disconnected from mains power earlier in the shift.
immediate_action_taken: Pump reconnected to mains power and infusion restarted manually
patient_impact_observed: Brief interruption in medication delivery; duration not precisely documented
additional_notes: Staff did not note battery indicator status at the time of the pause

reported_problem: ECG tracing shows a wandering baseline and intermittent noise artifact across several leads, making the printed trace difficult to interpret cleanly.
clinical_context: Machine was used for a routine 12-lead ECG on an ambulatory patient; electrodes were placed following standard technique.
immediate_action_taken: Electrodes repositioned and tracing repeated once; artifact persisted
patient_impact_observed: Repeat ECG required; no delay in clinical decision-making reported
additional_notes: Staff unsure if the issue is cable-related or internal to the machine

reported_problem: During the weekly self-test, the defibrillator displayed a battery fault indicator. The device completed the self-test cycle but flagged the battery status as requiring attention.
clinical_context: This is the primary defibrillator stationed on the emergency department resuscitation trolley.
immediate_action_taken: Battery reseated once; fault indicator reappeared on repeat self-test
patient_impact_observed: No patient use since the fault was identified; device has not yet been removed from the resuscitation trolley
additional_notes: No backup defibrillator has been placed on the trolley yet

reported_problem: Defibrillator's pacing function did not respond during a routine equipment check before the start of the theatre list. The defibrillation function itself was not tested as part of this check.
clinical_context: Device is kept in the operating theatre for intraoperative use; the theatre list for the day includes a cardiac procedure.
equipment_status_at_report: Powered on, pacing function unresponsive during check
immediate_action_taken: Device power-cycled once; pacing check not repeated before this report was filed
patient_impact_observed: None yet; the theatre list has not started
additional_notes: Theatre staff are awaiting guidance on whether the case can proceed with this device in place

reported_problem: Oxygen concentrator supplying a ventilated patient is producing a lower-than-expected output reading on its built-in flow indicator, though the unit is still running and audible alarms have not triggered.
clinical_context: The patient is fully dependent on supplemental oxygen delivery in the ICU; nursing staff noticed the discrepancy during a routine hourly check.
equipment_status_at_report: Running, output reading below expected level
immediate_action_taken: Flow indicator checked twice with the same reading; oxygen tubing inspected for visible kinks with none found
patient_impact_observed: Patient's oxygen saturation remains within target range at time of report
additional_notes: Equipment register lists this unit's criticality as medium; unit is currently supporting a fully oxygen-dependent ICU patient

reported_problem: Suction machine's carrying handle has cracked and the unit's exterior casing has a visible chip near the base. The machine continues to generate suction at the expected level.
clinical_context: Used for routine ward suctioning; no change in suction performance has been noticed.
additional_notes: Cosmetic damage only, reported during routine equipment check

reported_problem: Analyzer's scheduled quarterly calibration is due according to the maintenance log posted on the device. No performance issues have been observed on recent quality control runs.
clinical_context: Routine laboratory equipment management check ahead of the next reporting period.
equipment_status_at_report: In service, performing within expected range
additional_notes: Last calibration record on file predates the current quarter

reported_problem: Patient monitor is showing intermittent dropouts in the SpO2 waveform, with the numeric reading occasionally freezing for several seconds before resuming.
clinical_context: Patient is undergoing continuous monitoring after a suspected overdose and has a fluctuating level of consciousness; staff are relying on the monitor's readings to track trend changes closely.
immediate_action_taken: Probe checked and reseated once; issue recurred within a few minutes
patient_impact_observed: Staff report increased difficulty confirming the patient's respiratory status between manual checks
additional_notes: Same symptom description as a previously reported ICU monitor case, different unit

reported_problem: Infusion pump is not working properly. Staff are requesting equipment support.
additional_notes: This is the same pump reported in MR-002 approximately two weeks earlier

reported_problem: Defibrillator passed its most recent self-test with no faults indicated, but a staff member reports that during a resuscitation event two days ago, the device seemed to take longer than usual to charge before delivering a shock. No fault code appeared on the display at the time.
clinical_context: The event in question was a real resuscitation attempt; the patient outcome is not part of this report. Staff impressions of the delay vary between those present.
immediate_action_taken: Self-test run twice with no fault found; device returned to the resuscitation trolley
patient_impact_observed: Possible delay in shock delivery during the resuscitation event, as recalled by staff; not confirmed by device data
additional_notes: This is the same physical defibrillator reported in MR-007 for a battery fault; it is not stated in this report whether that fault was resolved before this event
